nodes.does: The MOD's consolidated defence-innovation body (£400m/yr; ~£1.6bn in the DIP); now the NAD Group's National Armaments Innovation area alongside Dstl, having absorbed the Defence & Security Accelerator (DASA).
nodes.oppsOverride: UKDI competitions — including the multi-cycle ‘Innovation Support to Operations’ themed competition (fast, TRL 6+, months not years) plus wider themed and loan routes. Live cycles and the five innovation themes appear on gov.uk and the UKDI submission service.
nodes.funding: Funds directly. The UK Defence Innovation front door channels problem-holders to funded competitions and pipelines; award sizes vary by route.

nodes.label: UK Export Finance (UKEF)
nodes.does: The UK export credit agency; finances and insures defence and dual-use exports.

nodes.label: UK Research & Innovation (UKRI)
nodes.does: Public research & innovation funder underpinning the science base.

nodes.label: Ultra
nodes.does: Sonar, C2 and specialist electronics.

nodes.label: Ursa Major
nodes.does: Rocket and hypersonic propulsion manufacturing.

nodes.label: 8VC
nodes.does: Joe Lonsdale's fund (Palantir co-founder) — a heavy backer of defence and govtech, including Epirus, Saronic and Anduril.

nodes.label: a16z American Dynamism
nodes.does: Andreessen Horowitz's national-interest practice (led by Katherine Boyle and David Ulevitch) — backs aerospace, defence, manufacturing and dual-use; early in Anduril and many defence-tech names.

nodes.label: Acquisition, capital & scaling
nodes.does: How US innovation crosses into procurement.

nodes.label: AeroVironment
nodes.does: Small uncrewed aircraft and loitering munitions (Switchblade, Puma) — a leader in tactical UAS.

nodes.label: Department of the Air Force
nodes.does: The US Air Force — air, and the parent department of the Space Force.

nodes.label: Air & Space Forces Association (AFA)
nodes.does: The professional association for the Air Force and Space Force; advocacy, education and the ASC/AFA conferences.

nodes.label: AFCEA International
nodes.does: The association for defence C4ISR, communications, IT and cyber — a major government-industry bridge for the digital-defence community.

nodes.label: Specialist agencies
nodes.does: Space, missiles and threat reduction.

nodes.label: Aerospace Industries Association (AIA)
nodes.does: The trade association of the US aerospace and defence manufacturing sector — policy advocacy and standards for the primes and their supply chains.

nodes.label: Department of the Army
nodes.does: The US Army — land warfare; the largest service and a major acquisition authority.

nodes.label: Industry associations & professional bodies
nodes.does: The trade and professional associations — the collective industry voice and the government-industry forum.

nodes.label: Association of the US Army (AUSA)
nodes.does: The US Army's professional association and industry forum; runs the large AUSA Annual Meeting exposition.

nodes.label: Booz Allen Hamilton
nodes.does: The largest provider of AI and digital services to the US government; consulting, cyber and mission analytics.

nodes.label: CACI International
nodes.does: Technology and expertise for national security — SIGINT/EW, secure comms, software and intelligence support.

nodes.label: CISA
nodes.does: America's Cyber Defense Agency (DHS, ~3,600 staff) — protects federal networks and critical infrastructure; runs the Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative (JCDC) bridging government and industry.

nodes.label: CNA
nodes.does: Non-profit operating the Center for Naval Analyses FFRDC — operations research and analysis for the Navy, Marine Corps and DoD.

nodes.label: Cyber commands & agencies
nodes.does: The US cyber-defence establishment — the operational commands and the national cyber-defence agency.

nodes.label: US Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM)
nodes.does: The unified combatant command for cyberspace operations — defends DoD networks, supports combatant commanders and runs the Cyber Mission Force.

nodes.label: OUSD (R&E)
nodes.does: Under Secretary of Defense for Research & Engineering — the department's CTO; owns S&T strategy and critical-technology areas.

nodes.label: DoD Cyber Crime Center (DC3)
nodes.does: A designated Federal Cyber Center — digital forensics, cyber training and the DoD Vulnerability Disclosure Program (a front door for white-hat researchers).

nodes.label: Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA)
nodes.does: Administers DoD contracts — quality, delivery and cost oversight across the supplier base.

nodes.label: DCVC
nodes.does: Deep-tech venture firm backing national-security-relevant compute, space, autonomy and biosecurity.

nodes.label: Decisive Point
nodes.does: Early-stage venture firm dedicated to national security and the defence-industrial base.

nodes.label: Military Departments & Joint Staff
nodes.does: The three military departments and the Joint Chiefs — the top of the US defence structure.

nodes.label: Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA)
nodes.does: The DoD's IT and communications combat-support agency — networks, cloud and command-and-control.

nodes.label: Defense Innovation Unit (DIU)
nodes.entry: diu.mil · info@diu.mil · Silicon Valley, Boston, Austin, Chicago, DC
nodes.does: DoD's commercial-tech ‘open front door’; principal liaison to the innovation base. Runs Commercial Solutions Openings and leads Replicator.
nodes.oppsOverride: DIU posts Commercial Solutions Openings (CSOs) and Areas of Interest — see ‘Work With Us’ at diu.mil.

nodes.label: Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) & network
nodes.does: diu.mil · the DoD's commercial-tech front door.

nodes.label: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA)
nodes.does: The DoD's combat-support logistics and supply-chain agency — fuel, spares, subsistence and disposal.

nodes.label: US Department of Defense (DoD)
nodes.does: The US defence department (also styled the Department of War); the largest defence customer globally.
nodes.oppsOverride: US requirements posted on SAM.gov; small-business R&D via DoD SBIR/STTR (dodsbirsttr.mil).

nodes.label: Draper Laboratory
nodes.does: Not-for-profit R&D lab (Cambridge, MA) — guidance, navigation, control and microsystems, from strategic missiles to autonomous systems.

affiliation.note: a not-for-profit lab serving US government sponsors

nodes.label: US defence-tech scaleups
nodes.does: Venture-backed firms reshaping US capability.

nodes.label: FFRDCs & research institutes
nodes.does: Federally-funded R&D centres and analysis bodies.

nodes.label: Founders Fund
nodes.does: One of the most influential defence-tech investors — early in Palantir, Anduril and SpaceX; co-led Anduril's record rounds.

nodes.label: General Catalyst (Defense & Intelligence)
nodes.does: Large multistage firm with a growing national-security practice backing dual-use and defence scaleups.

nodes.label: Defense-wide agencies & acquisition authorities
nodes.does: The department-wide agencies that buy, sustain, connect and set acquisition policy.

nodes.label: Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI)
nodes.does: A designated University Affiliated Research Center (~3,100 staff) — applied research in EW, sensors, C4ISR, cyber and threat systems for national security.

affiliation.note: an independent university research center sponsored by the US DoD (UARC)

nodes.label: HII (Huntington Ingalls)
nodes.does: America's largest military shipbuilder — the sole builder of US aircraft carriers, a submarine builder, plus unmanned undersea systems and mission technologies.

nodes.label: Joint Chiefs of Staff
nodes.does: The Chairman and Joint Staff — military advice, requirements (JROC) and joint warfighting concepts.

nodes.label: Kratos Defense
nodes.does: Affordable systems at scale — jet drones (Valkyrie), target drones, hypersonics, space and C5ISR.

nodes.label: L3Harris Technologies
nodes.does: Top-tier prime — tactical communications, electronic warfare, space & mission systems, and (via Aerojet Rocketdyne) missile propulsion.

nodes.label: Research labs & S&T
nodes.does: The federal defence research base.

nodes.label: Leidos
nodes.does: The largest US defence IT/services integrator (~$17bn revenue) — ABMS, systems integration, autonomy and digital modernisation.

nodes.label: Leonardo DRS
nodes.does: US-based Leonardo subsidiary — sensing, electric power & propulsion, network computing and force protection.

affiliation.note: the Leonardo group, with major arms in Italy, the UK and the US (Leonardo DRS)

nodes.label: US mid-tier primes & integrators
nodes.does: Major defence contractors and services integrators below the top five — several are top-20 by defence revenue.

nodes.label: Department of the Navy
nodes.does: The US Navy and Marine Corps — sea, undersea, amphibious and naval-aviation power.

nodes.label: Navy League of the United States
nodes.does: The civilian association supporting the sea services; runs the Sea-Air-Space exposition.

nodes.label: National Defense Industrial Association (NDIA)
nodes.does: America's leading defence-industry association (est. 1919; ~1,700 corporate and 66,500 individual members) — the main legal/ethical government-industry forum, with subject divisions from munitions to cyber; publishes National Defense magazine and runs SOFIC and other events.

nodes.label: OUSD (A&S)
nodes.does: Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition & Sustainment — acquisition policy, the defense industrial base and sustainment.

nodes.label: Peraton
nodes.does: Mission-focused national-security integrator across space, cyber, intelligence and communications.

nodes.label: US & global primes — divisions
nodes.does: The largest US-headquartered primes, broken down by business segment.

nodes.label: Razor's Edge Ventures
nodes.does: Specialist national-security venture firm — early defence-and-intelligence dual-use investing.

nodes.label: RTX Ventures
nodes.does: The corporate venture arm of RTX (Raytheon) — strategic investment in Ursa Major, Hermeus, EnCharge and other dual-use hardware.

nodes.label: SAIC
nodes.does: Government-services and systems-integration prime — digital engineering, space and enterprise IT for the DoD and intelligence community.

nodes.label: Scout Ventures
nodes.does: Seed-stage, veteran-led fund investing in dual-use frontier technology out of the national labs and services.

nodes.label: Software Engineering Institute (SEI, CMU)
nodes.does: DoD-sponsored FFRDC at Carnegie Mellon (OUSD R&E) — software engineering, systems engineering and cybersecurity; home of the CERT Division.

affiliation.note: an independent institution sponsored by a US federal agency (FFRDC)

nodes.label: Service innovation & rapid-capability units
nodes.does: Army, Navy and SOF fronts doors.

nodes.label: Shield Capital
nodes.does: Early-stage fund (co-founded by former DIU director Michael Brown) focused on dual-use defence, cyber, AI and space.

nodes.label: Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC)
nodes.does: Aircraft modification and integration, ISR and C2 — including the Army's HADES deep-sensing spy-plane programme.

nodes.label: US Special Operations Command (SOCOM)
nodes.does: The unified command for special operations; its own acquisition authority (SOF AT&L) and a fast innovation buyer.

nodes.label: US Space Force
nodes.does: The newest service (est. 2019) — space warfighting, launch and on-orbit capability.

nodes.label: US National Defense Strategy
nodes.does: The Department of Defense's capstone strategy directing force posture, priorities and the pacing challenge; issued by the Secretary of Defense and published via defense.gov.

nodes.label: US National Security Strategy
nodes.does: The White House's overarching statement of national-security priorities, from which the National Defense Strategy flows.

nodes.label: US defence & dual-use venture capital
nodes.does: The private-capital engine behind the American defence-tech surge — the specialist funds writing the checks.

nodes.label: 201 Ventures
nodes.entry: Madrid · via European Defense Investor Network
nodes.does: Solo-GP pre-seed/seed fund (Eric Slesinger) backing intelligence, defence and dual-use in Europe; find it via EDIN or Dealroom.

nodes.label: Vannevar Labs
nodes.does: Intelligence and operational software for national security.

nodes.label: University of Warwick (WMG)
nodes.does: Digital manufacturing, materials and systems engineering.

nodes.label: West Freugh Range
nodes.does: Air-weapons and instrumented trials range in south-west Scotland.

nodes.label: Windracers
nodes.does: Autonomous heavy-lift fixed-wing UAV for logistics and resupply.

nodes.label: Army xTech
nodes.does: The Army's open prize-competition programme for dual-use tech from non-traditional vendors.
nodes.oppsOverride: Army xTech prize competitions for non-traditional vendors at xtech.army.mil.

nations_procurement.al: Albania — the electronic procurement system (app.gov.al); defence via the Ministry of Defence (mod.gov.al).
nations_procurement.au: Australia — tenders via AusTender (tenders.gov.au); defence innovation via ASCA (asca.gov.au).
nations_procurement.be: Belgium — federal procurement on e-Procurement (publicprocurement.be); defence buys via DG MR (mil.be).
nations_procurement.bg: Bulgaria — the Public Procurement Agency register (app.eop.bg); defence via the Ministry of Defence (mod.bg).
nations_procurement.ca: Canada — federal tenders via CanadaBuys (canadabuys.canada.ca); defence innovation via Defence IDEaS and BOREALIS (canada.ca).
nations_procurement.cz: Czechia — the national e-procurement portal; defence via the Defence Armament & Acquisition Agency (army.cz).
nations_procurement.de: Germany — federal e-procurement via e-Vergabe / DTVP; BAAINBw is the buying authority (baainbw.de); start-up routes via the Cyber Innovation Hub (cyberinnovationhub.de).
nations_procurement.dk: Denmark — public tenders on udbud.dk; defence acquisition via DALO (fmi.dk).
nations_procurement.ee: Estonia — the national public procurement register (riigihanked.riik.ee); defence buys via the Estonian Centre for Defence Investment (kaitseinvesteeringud.ee).
nations_procurement.es: Spain — the Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (contrataciondelestado.es); defence via DGAM (defensa.gob.es).
nations_procurement.fi: Finland — public tenders on Hilma (hankintailmoitukset.fi); defence materiel via the Logistics Command (logistiikkalaitos.fi).
nations_procurement.fr: France — public tenders on PLACE (marches-publics.gouv.fr); defence industry via the DGA's IXARM portal (ixarm.com); innovation via AID (defense.gouv.fr).
nations_procurement.gr: Greece — the national procurement system (promitheus.gov.gr); defence via GDAEED (mod.mil.gr).
nations_procurement.hr: Croatia — the Electronic Public Procurement Classifieds (eojn.hr); defence via the Ministry of Defence (morh.hr).
nations_procurement.hu: Hungary — public procurement via the EKR system (ekr.gov.hu); defence via the Ministry of Defence and Defence Procurement Agency (kormany.hu).
nations_procurement.il: Israel — programmes via the Israeli MoD and DDR&D/MAFAT (mod.gov.il); industry engagement via the primes (Rafael, IAI, Elbit).
nations_procurement.is: Iceland — public tenders via Ríkiskaup / the central purchasing body (utbodsvefur.is); defence-related procurement via the Coast Guard and Ministry for Foreign Affairs (government.is).
nations_procurement.it: Italy — Segredifesa procurement (difesa.it) and the Consip/MEPA platform (acquistinretepa.it); above-threshold notices on TED (ted.europa.eu).
nations_procurement.jp: Japan — defence procurement and R&D via ATLA (mod.go.jp/atla); engagement through the prime contractors.
nations_procurement.kr: South Korea — defence programmes via DAPA (dapa.go.kr) and the D2B defence e-procurement system; R&D via ADD.
nations_procurement.lt: Lithuania — the Central Public Procurement portal (cvpp.eviesiejipirkimai.lt); defence materiel via the Defence Materiel Agency (kam.lt).
nations_procurement.lu: Luxembourg — public tenders via the government portal (pmp.b2g.etat.lu); defence via the Directorate of Defence (defense.gouvernement.lu).
nations_procurement.lv: Latvia — the national procurement portal (eis.gov.lv); defence via the Ministry of Defence (mod.gov.lv).
nations_procurement.me: Montenegro — the electronic public procurement system (cejn.gov.me); defence via the Ministry of Defence (gov.me).
nations_procurement.mk: North Macedonia — the public procurement bureau (e-nabavki.gov.mk); defence via the Ministry of Defence (mod.gov.mk).
nations_procurement.nl: Netherlands — national tenders on TenderNed (tenderned.nl); defence buys via the DMO (defensie.nl).
nations_procurement.no: Norway — public tenders on Doffin (doffin.no); defence materiel via the NDMA (forsvarsmateriell.no).
nations_procurement.nz: New Zealand — government tenders via GETS (gets.govt.nz); capability via the Ministry of Defence (defence.govt.nz).
nations_procurement.pl: Poland — e-Zamowienia (ezamowienia.gov.pl); defence buys via the Armament Agency (wojsko-polskie.pl).
nations_procurement.pt: Portugal — public tenders via the national portal (base.gov.pt); defence industry engagement via idD Portugal Defence (iddportugal.pt) and DGRDN.
nations_procurement.ro: Romania — the electronic public procurement system (e-licitatie.ro); defence programmes via the Ministry of National Defence (mapn.ro).
nations_procurement.se: Sweden — FMV procurement (fmv.se); notices via the national e-procurement systems (e.g. TendSign/Mercell) and TED (ted.europa.eu).
nations_procurement.si: Slovenia — public tenders on e-JN (ejn.gov.si); defence via the Ministry of Defence (gov.si/mo).
nations_procurement.sk: Slovakia — public tenders via the Electronic Contracting System / ÚVO (uvo.gov.sk); defence acquisition via the Ministry of Defence (mosr.sk).
nations_procurement.tr: Türkiye — defence programmes run through the Presidency of Defence Industries / SSB (ssb.gov.tr); industry engagement via the primes and TEKNOFEST/SAHA events.
nations_procurement.ua: Ukraine — public tenders via Prozorro (prozorro.gov.ua); defence innovation and testing via Brave1 (brave1.gov.ua).
nations_procurement.uk: UK — tenders on Find a Tender (www.find-tender.service.gov.uk) and Contracts Finder; MOD suppliers via the Defence Sourcing Portal (Jaggaer). Innovation via UKDI/DASA competitions (gov.uk).
nations_procurement.us: US — opportunities on SAM.gov; defence innovation via DIU (diu.mil) and DoD SBIR/STTR (dodsbirsttr.mil); service routes via AFWERX, Army xTech and NavalX.
nations_procurement.nato: NATO — NSPA business opportunities (nspa.nato.int) and NCI Agency e-procurement (ncia.nato.int); innovation via DIANA challenges (diana.nato.int).
nations_procurement.multi: Multinational programme — opportunities flow via the partner nations' portals and the programme office (e.g. OCCAR, occar.int).
nations_procurement.eu_inst: EU — the Funding & Tenders portal (ec.europa.eu) for EDF/EUDIS calls, and TED (ted.europa.eu) for above-threshold contracts.
